questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.firstname ,  T1.lastname FROM list AS T1 JOIN teachers AS T2 ON T1.classroom  =  T2.classroom WHERE T2.firstname  =  "MARROTTE" AND T2.lastname  =  "KIRK"

questions.question: Find the name of the teacher who teaches the largest number of students.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T2.firstname ,  T2.lastname FROM list AS T1 JOIN teachers AS T2 ON T1.classroom  =  T2.classroom GROUP BY T2.firstname ,  T2.lastname ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What are the first and last names of the first-grade students who are NOT taught by teacher OTHA MOYER?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.firstname ,  T1.lastname FROM list AS T1 JOIN teachers AS T2 ON T1.classroom  =  T2.classroom WHERE T1.grade  =  1 EXCEPT SELECT T1.firstname ,  T1.lastname FROM list AS T1 JOIN teachers AS T2 ON T1.classroom  =  T2.classroom WHERE T2.firstname  =  "OTHA" AND T2.lastname  =  "MOYER"

questions.question: What are the names of the cameras that have taken picture of the most mountains?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T2.name FROM photos AS T1 JOIN camera_lens AS T2 ON T1.camera_lens_id  =  T2.id GROUP BY T2.id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Show the name and prominence of the mountains whose picture is not taken by a lens of brand 'Sigma'.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT name ,  prominence FROM mountain EXCEPT SELECT T1.name ,  T1.prominence FROM mountain AS T1 JOIN photos AS T2 ON T1.id  =  T2.mountain_id JOIN camera_lens AS T3 ON T2.camera_lens_id  =  T3.id WHERE T3.brand  =  'Sigma'

questions.question: List the brands of lenses that took both a picture of mountains with range 'Toubkal Atlas' and a picture of mountains with range 'Lasta Massif'
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T3.brand FROM mountain AS T1 JOIN photos AS T2 ON T1.id  =  T2.mountain_id JOIN camera_lens AS T3 ON T2.camera_lens_id  =  T3.id WHERE T1.range  =  'Toubkal Atlas' INTERSECT SELECT T3.brand FROM mountain AS T1 JOIN photos AS T2 ON T1.id  =  T2.mountain_id JOIN camera_lens AS T3 ON T2.camera_lens_id  =  T3.id WHERE T1.range  =  'Lasta Massif'

questions.question: What are the names of photos taken with the lens brand 'Sigma' or 'Olympus'?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.name FROM camera_lens AS T1 JOIN photos AS T2 ON T2.camera_lens_id  =  T1.id WHERE T1.brand  =  'Sigma' OR T1.brand  =  'Olympus'

questions.question: How many camera lenses are not used in taking any photos?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM camera_lens WHERE id NOT IN ( SELECT camera_lens_id FROM photos )

questions.question: Show all storm names affecting region "Denmark".
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T3.name FROM affected_region AS T1 JOIN region AS T2 ON T1.region_id  =  T2.region_id JOIN storm AS T3 ON T1.storm_id  =  T3.storm_id WHERE T2.region_name  =  'Denmark'

questions.question: Show storm name with at least two regions and 10 cities affected.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.name FROM storm AS T1 JOIN affected_region AS T2 ON T1.storm_id  =  T2.storm_id GROUP BY T1.storm_id HAVING count(*)  >=  2 INTERSECT SELECT T1.name FROM storm AS T1 JOIN affected_region AS T2 ON T1.storm_id  =  T2.storm_id GROUP BY T1.storm_id HAVING sum(T2.number_city_affected)  >=  10

questions.question: Show the name for regions not affected.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT region_name FROM region WHERE region_id NOT IN (SELECT region_id FROM affected_region)

questions.question: What are the names of storms that both affected two or more regions and affected a total of 10 or more cities?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.name FROM storm AS T1 JOIN affected_region AS T2 ON T1.storm_id  =  T2.storm_id GROUP BY T1.storm_id HAVING count(*)  >=  2 INTERSECT SELECT T1.name FROM storm AS T1 JOIN affected_region AS T2 ON T1.storm_id  =  T2.storm_id GROUP BY T1.storm_id HAVING sum(T2.number_city_affected)  >=  10

questions.question: What are the names of storms that did not affect two or more regions?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT name FROM storm EXCEPT SELECT T1.name FROM storm AS T1 JOIN affected_region AS T2 ON T1.storm_id  =  T2.storm_id GROUP BY T1.storm_id HAVING count(*)  >=  2

questions.question: Find the ids and names of members who are under age 30 or with black membership card.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT name ,  member_id FROM member WHERE Membership_card  =  'Black' OR age  <  30

questions.question: Which month has the most happy hours?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT MONTH FROM happy_hour GROUP BY MONTH ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Find the id and address of the shops whose score is below the average score.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT shop_id ,  address FROM shop WHERE score  <  (SELECT avg(score) FROM shop)

questions.question: What is the membership card held by both members living in Hartford and ones living in Waterbury address?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT membership_card FROM member WHERE address  =  'Hartford' INTERSECT SELECT membership_card FROM member WHERE address  =  'Waterbury'

questions.question: Find the address and staff number of the shops that do not have any happy hour.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT address ,  num_of_staff FROM shop WHERE shop_id NOT IN (SELECT shop_id FROM happy_hour)

questions.question: What are the names of the tourist attractions that have parking or shopping as their feature details?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.Name FROM Tourist_Attractions AS T1 JOIN Tourist_Attraction_Features AS T2 ON T1.tourist_attraction_id  =  T2.tourist_attraction_id JOIN Features AS T3 ON T2.Feature_ID  =  T3.Feature_ID WHERE T3.feature_Details  =  'park' UNION SELECT T1.Name FROM Tourist_Attractions AS T1 JOIN Tourist_Attraction_Features AS T2 ON T1.tourist_attraction_id  =  T2.tourist_attraction_id JOIN Features AS T3 ON T2.Feature_ID  =  T3.Feature_ID WHERE T3.feature_Details  =  'shopping'

questions.question: What are the names and opening hours of the tourist attractions that can be accessed by bus or walk?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Name ,  Opening_Hours FROM TOURIST_ATTRACTIONS WHERE How_to_Get_There  =  "bus" OR How_to_Get_There  =  "walk"

questions.question: Find the tourist attractions that have parking or shopping as their feature details. What are the names of the attractions?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.Name FROM Tourist_Attractions AS T1 JOIN Tourist_Attraction_Features AS T2 ON T1.tourist_attraction_id  =  T2.tourist_attraction_id JOIN Features AS T3 ON T2.Feature_ID  =  T3.Feature_ID WHERE T3.feature_Details  =  'park' UNION SELECT T1.Name FROM Tourist_Attractions AS T1 JOIN Tourist_Attraction_Features AS T2 ON T1.tourist_attraction_id  =  T2.tourist_attraction_id JOIN Features AS T3 ON T2.Feature_ID  =  T3.Feature_ID WHERE T3.feature_Details  =  'shopping'

questions.question: For each tourist attraction, return its name and the date when the tourists named Vincent or Vivian visited there.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.Name ,  T3.Visit_Date FROM Tourist_Attractions AS T1 JOIN VISITORS AS T2 JOIN VISITS AS T3 ON T1.Tourist_Attraction_ID  =  T3.Tourist_Attraction_ID AND T2.Tourist_ID  =  T3.Tourist_ID WHERE T2.Tourist_Details  =  "Vincent" OR T2.Tourist_Details  =  "Vivian"

questions.question: What are the details of the markets that can be accessed by walk or bus?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.Market_Details FROM Street_Markets AS T1 JOIN TOURIST_ATTRACTIONS AS T2 ON T1.Market_ID  =  T2.Tourist_Attraction_ID WHERE T2.How_to_Get_There  =  "walk" OR  T2.How_to_Get_There  =  "bus"

questions.question: How many products are never booked with amount higher than 200?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Products_for_hire WHERE product_id NOT IN ( SELECT product_id FROM products_booked WHERE booked_amount  >  200 )

questions.question: What are the start date and end date of the booking that has booked the product named 'Book collection A'?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T3.booking_start_date ,   T3.booking_end_date FROM Products_for_hire AS T1 JOIN products_booked AS T2 ON T1.product_id  =  T2.product_id JOIN bookings AS T3 ON T2.booking_id  =  T3.booking_id WHERE T1.product_name  =  'Book collection A'

questions.question: What are the coupon amount of the coupons owned by both good and bad customers?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.coupon_amount FROM Discount_Coupons AS T1 JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.coupon_id  =  T2.coupon_id WHERE T2.good_or_bad_customer  =  'good' INTERSECT SELECT T1.coupon_amount FROM Discount_Coupons AS T1 JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.coupon_id  =  T2.coupon_id WHERE T2.good_or_bad_customer  =  'bad'

questions.question: What is the maximum total amount paid by a customer? List the customer id and amount.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT customer_id ,  sum(amount_paid) FROM Payments GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY sum(amount_paid) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What are the id and the amount of refund of the booking that incurred the most times of payments?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.booking_id ,  T1.amount_of_refund FROM Bookings AS T1 JOIN Payments AS T2 ON T1.booking_id  =  T2.booking_id GROUP BY T1.booking_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What is the name of the perpetrator with the biggest weight.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.Name FROM people AS T1 JOIN perpetrator AS T2 ON T1.People_ID  =  T2.People_ID ORDER BY T1.Weight DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What is the country that has the most perpetrators?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Country ,  COUNT(*) FROM perpetrator GROUP BY Country ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Show the countries that have both perpetrators with injures more than 50 and perpetrators with injures smaller than 20.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Country FROM perpetrator WHERE Injured  >  50 INTERSECT SELECT Country FROM perpetrator WHERE Injured  <  20

questions.question: List the names of people that are not perpetrators.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM people WHERE People_ID NOT IN (SELECT People_ID FROM perpetrator)

questions.question: What are the names of perpetrators in country "China" or "Japan"?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.Name FROM people AS T1 JOIN perpetrator AS T2 ON T1.People_ID  =  T2.People_ID WHERE T2.Country  =  "China" OR T2.Country  =  "Japan"

questions.question: What is the most frequent status of bookings?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT Status_Code FROM BOOKINGS GROUP BY Status_Code ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Show all the distinct product names with price higher than the average.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT Product_Name FROM PRODUCTS WHERE Product_Price  >  (SELECT avg(Product_Price) FROM PRODUCTS)

questions.question: What are the distinct names of the products that cost more than the average?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT Product_Name FROM PRODUCTS WHERE Product_Price  >  (SELECT avg(Product_Price) FROM PRODUCTS)

questions.question: What are the order dates of orders with price higher than 1000?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.Order_Date FROM Customer_Orders AS T1 JOIN ORDER_ITEMS AS T2 ON T1.Order_ID  =  T2.Order_ID JOIN Products AS T3 ON T2.Product_ID  =  T3.Product_ID WHERE T3.Product_price  >  1000

questions.question: What is the payment method code used by the most orders?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT payment_method_code FROM INVOICES GROUP BY payment_method_code ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What is the average fastest lap speed for races held after 2004, for each race, ordered by year?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT avg(T2.fastestlapspeed) ,  T1.name ,  T1.year FROM races AS T1 JOIN results AS T2 ON T1.raceid = T2.raceid WHERE T1.year > 2014 GROUP BY T1.name ORDER BY T1.year

questions.question: What is the id and first name of all the drivers who participated in the Australian Grand Prix and the Chinese Grand Prix?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T2.driverid ,  T3.forename FROM races AS T1 JOIN results AS T2 ON T1.raceid = T2.raceid JOIN drivers AS T3 ON T2.driverid  =  T3.driverid WHERE T1.name = "Australian Grand Prix" INTERSECT SELECT T2.driverid ,  T3.forename FROM races AS T1 JOIN results AS T2 ON T1.raceid = T2.raceid JOIN drivers AS T3 ON T2.driverid  =  T3.driverid WHERE T1.name = "Chinese Grand Prix"

questions.question: What are the different ids and stop durations of all the drivers whose stop lasted longer than the driver in the race with the id 841?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT driverid ,  STOP FROM pitstops WHERE duration  >  (SELECT min(duration) FROM pitstops WHERE raceid  =  841)

questions.question: Find the id and location of circuits that belong to France or Belgium?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT circuitid ,  LOCATION FROM circuits WHERE country = "France" OR country = "Belgium"

questions.question: What are the ids and last names of all drivers who participated in the most races?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.driverid ,  T1.surname FROM drivers AS T1 JOIN results AS T2 ON T1.driverid = T2.driverid JOIN races AS T3 ON T2.raceid = T3.raceid GROUP BY T1.driverid ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What are the title and director of the films without any schedule?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT title ,  directed_by FROM film WHERE film_id NOT IN (SELECT film_id FROM schedule)

questions.question: What is the location with the most cinemas opened in year 2010 or later?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT LOCATION FROM cinema WHERE openning_year  >=  2010 GROUP BY LOCATION ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Show all the locations where some cinemas were opened in both year 2010 and year 2011.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT LOCATION FROM cinema WHERE openning_year  =  2010 INTERSECT SELECT LOCATION FROM cinema WHERE openning_year  =  2011

questions.question: Show director with the largest number of show times in total.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T2.directed_by FROM schedule AS T1 JOIN film AS T2 ON T1.film_id  =  T2.film_id GROUP BY T2.directed_by ORDER BY sum(T1.show_times_per_day) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Show all the locations where no cinema has capacity over 800.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT LOCATION FROM cinema EXCEPT SELECT LOCATION FROM cinema WHERE capacity  >  800
